Both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal_distance_km and exceeds 0.8 km in absolute terms. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure to govern over the rounded trip_record copy, and the trace figure is the one cited here.

The driver's own explanation is that traffic was heavy so he took another road. That is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory artifact in the bundle is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver names no advisory evidence ID, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, and the deviation stands at the measured figure.

No rider-requested detour can excuse any part of the excess. The chat log for this trip carries zero messages, so there is no rider instruction recorded, no waypoint_hint to test, and POL-RD-04 is unavailable on the record. The driver cannot point to a specific artifact and clause to shift the burden back.

No relocation of the pickup or dropoff point can excuse the excess either. The trip record shows original_pickup and original_dropoff both null, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null. POL-RD-05 cannot be run and no amended optimal exists to re-apply POL-RD-01 against.

The trip is not a pooled trip, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The trip record shows vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. The baseline for the threshold test is therefore the booked optimal of 11.4 km, not any matched-itinerary figure.

The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy and POL-RD-11 does not. The fare breakdown records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so there is no upfront quote to cap the rider's recovery.

The refund is arithmetic. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 3.45. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact that carries it.

No ERP or toll pass-through correction is due. The fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and a tolls_erp figure of 0.00, and the optimal route ERP is 0.00. There is no off-route gantry charge to refund separately, and no airport surcharge line to test, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

No POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral is available on this record, and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the field POL-RD-06 names.

The rider's other profile fields, including prior_disputes_filed and prior_no_show_flags, are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground no finding.

The deviation may be established on the trace alone and no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) is engaged.

ruling.explanation:
Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.45. The trip was genuinely longer than the booked optimal route, and the difference in distance and time is refunded; everything else on the fare stands.

Both of you agree on the essentials and the record supports it. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02802, weight_multiplier 1.0) ran 14.56 km against the booked optimal of 11.4 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02802, weight_multiplier 1.0). That is an excess of 3.16 km, or 27.72% of optimal, which clears both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%). The trace figure governs over the rounded 14.6 km convenience copy on the trip record. The trace is not impaired: 100% coverage, 115 fixes at a 10-second interval, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) does not fire, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

No exculpatory clause applies. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02802) is empty, so there is no rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04); there is no pickup or dropoff amendment, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not displace the 11.4 km baseline. The driver's statement that "traffic was heavy so I took another road" is an assertion of an external traffic cause. Under POL-RD-13 that assertion is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-02802-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). POL-RD-03 is therefore unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. This does not escalate the case under POL-RD-10(5), because the driver cited no advisory identifier; POL-RD-13(1) makes the absent advisory a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, run against the booked optimal route. The fare model is METERED with no upfront quote, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 11.4 + 0.28 x 15.4) at surge 1.0 (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact that carries it) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = SGD 17.4620. charged_total is SGD 20.87. Refund = 20.87 - 17.4620 = SGD 3.4080, rounded up to SGD 3.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 16.3% of the charge, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a partial refund.

POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top: the fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and no surcharge line, so there is no pass-through or billing-integrity correction. POL-RD-06 produces no uplift and no conduct referral: the deviation is not MATERIAL (27.72%, below 50% and below 8.0 km) and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 295 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat pattern is established and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the field that clause names. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d of 0) does not impose any extra corroboration requirement, and the other profile fields on either side are context only under POL-GEN-01. No referral under POL-RD-06(c), POL-RD-09(4), POL-NS-05(ii) or POL-NS-07 is produced by this case.

The monetary effect of SGD 3.45 does not exceed the execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so under POL-GEN-05 this provisional ruling is executed automatically. Two advocate claims were discarded at the citation stage for citing the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02802-01 without naming its issue code; that discard does not affect the arithmetic, which rests on weight-1.0 artifacts throughout.
